title: Blank the Spire - Custom StS2 classes - weekly updates: can't grok the groq
author: unwittingyeti
selftext:
What's up good-looking gamers,

A huge THANK YOU to everyone who has played Blank the Spire. One person playing Blank the Spire is worth 1000lbs of lazy anti-ai hate from the mainstream subs <3

Hey Groq... are you okay? I was told you are an AI provider but every single API call I make to you gets borked, bounced or bonked. How do you work? Why do I only have access to tiny models on my api key despite the fact that my credit card is in my hand?  
  
I think they rented all their compute out (which might actually be the wise business plan lol)

Double thank you to everyone who tried to forge with a Groq key and failed. To anyone who did this I have added a native forge token to each of your accounts as a thank you for being my test creatures.

**TLDR:** Groq is weird to support, but the second-most requested platform. I can't figure out how to test it due to lack of 'developer access' despite having card in hand, ready to pay for it.

Check out Blank the Spire here: [https://blankthespire.com/](https://blankthespire.com/)

Grab the mod from Steam here: [https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3803255976](https://steamcommunity.com/sharedfiles/filedetails/?id=3803255976)
